# Spotify
> Spotify is a digital music service that gives users access to millions of songs, albums, artists, playlists, podcasts, and audiobooks.

Spotify spans consumer listening, creator publishing, developer APIs, advertising, and business tools. This file highlights the main documentation, platform, support, and product areas most useful for language models.

## Main Product
- [Web Player](https://open.spotify.com/): Browser-based Spotify player for streaming music, podcasts, and audiobooks.
- [Premium](https://www.spotify.com/premium/): Overview of paid Spotify plans and premium listening features.
- [Free](https://www.spotify.com/free/): Information about Spotify’s free listening experience and supported features.
- [Download](https://www.spotify.com/download/): Download Spotify apps for desktop and mobile devices.
- [Audiobooks](https://www.spotify.com/audiobooks/): Discover Spotify’s audiobook offering and listening experience.
- [Support](https://support.spotify.com/): Help center for accounts, billing, playback, devices, and troubleshooting.

## Developer Platform
- [Spotify for Developers](https://developer.spotify.com/): Central hub for Spotify APIs, SDKs, documentation, and developer tools.
- [Web API](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api): Reference and guides for Spotify catalog and user data APIs.
- [Web Playback SDK](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-playback-sdk): JavaScript SDK for controlling Spotify playback in web applications.
- [iOS SDK](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/ios): Native iOS integration for Spotify authentication and app features.
- [Android SDK](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/android): Native Android integration for Spotify authentication and playback features.
- [Developer Dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard/): Manage Spotify apps, credentials, users, and API settings.

## Web API Reference
- [Reference Overview](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference): Entry point for all Spotify Web API endpoints.
- [Authorization Guide](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/concepts/authorization): OAuth flows and authentication concepts for Spotify integrations.
- [Get Current User's Profile](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/get-current-users-profile): Retrieve profile information for the authenticated Spotify user.
- [Get Track](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/get-track): Fetch detailed metadata for a single Spotify track.
- [Get Album](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/get-an-album): Fetch metadata and details for a Spotify album.
- [Get Artist](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/get-an-artist): Fetch metadata and details for a Spotify artist.
- [Get Playlist](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/get-playlist): Retrieve playlist metadata, tracks, and ownership details.
- [Search](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/reference/search): Search Spotify catalog content across supported item types.

## Developer Guides
- [Getting Started](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/tutorials/getting-started): Introductory guide to building with the Spotify Web API.
- [Client Credentials Flow](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/tutorials/client-credentials-flow): Authenticate server-side applications without user authorization.
- [Authorization Code Flow](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/tutorials/code-flow): Authenticate applications acting on behalf of Spotify users.
- [PKCE Flow](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/tutorials/code-pkce-flow): Secure authorization flow for mobile and single-page applications.
- [Refresh Tokens](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/tutorials/refreshing-tokens): Renew expired access tokens for authorized Spotify applications.
- [Rate Limits](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/web-api/concepts/rate-limits): Understand request limits and best practices for API usage.

## For Artists
- [Spotify for Artists](https://artists.spotify.com/): Tools for artists to manage profiles, music, audience, and performance insights.
- [Artists Help](https://support.spotify.com/us/artists/): Support resources for artist accounts, releases, teams, and profile management.
- [Claim Your Profile](https://artists.spotify.com/claim): Start the process to access and manage an artist profile.
- [Artist Team Management](https://support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/team-management/): Manage access and permissions for artist team members.
- [Music Analytics](https://artists.spotify.com/features/analytics): Explore listener, stream, and audience analytics for artists.
- [Marquee](https://artists.spotify.com/features/marquee): Promotional campaign tool for reaching likely listeners on Spotify.

## For Podcasters and Publishers
- [Spotify for Creators](https://creators.spotify.com/): Platform for podcast and creator publishing, analytics, and audience growth.
- [Spotify for Creators Help](https://support.spotify.com/us/creators/): Help resources for publishing, monetization, analytics, and account management.
- [Podcast Publishing](https://creators.spotify.com/podcasters): Overview of podcast creation and distribution tools.
- [Analytics](https://creators.spotify.com/features/analytics): Audience and episode performance insights for creators.
- [Monetization](https://creators.spotify.com/features/monetization): Monetization options for eligible creators on Spotify.
- [Audience Growth](https://creators.spotify.com/features/growth): Tools and features for growing a creator audience.

## Advertising
- [Spotify Advertising](https://ads.spotify.com/): Advertising platform for reaching Spotify listeners through audio and digital campaigns.
- [Ad Studio](https://ads.spotify.com/en-US/ad-studio/): Self-serve ad creation and campaign management for Spotify advertising.
- [Advertising Help](https://ads.spotify.com/en-US/help/): Support resources for advertisers, campaigns, billing, and policies.
- [Measurement](https://ads.spotify.com/en-US/measurement/): Information about campaign measurement and reporting capabilities.
- [Creative Solutions](https://ads.spotify.com/en-US/creative-solutions/): Ad formats and creative options for Spotify campaigns.
- [Audience Targeting](https://ads.spotify.com/en-US/targeting/): Overview of targeting capabilities for Spotify advertising campaigns.

## Business and Enterprise
- [Spotify for Business](https://spotifyforbusiness.com/): Commercial music solutions for businesses and customer-facing environments.
- [Business Help Center](https://support.spotify.com/us/business/): Support resources for Spotify business products and account issues.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://www.spotify.com/us/business/): Overview of Spotify offerings for business and workplace use.
- [Brand Guidelines](https://developer.spotify.com/documentation/design): Design guidance for using Spotify assets in applications.
- [Legal](https://www.spotify.com/legal/): Central hub for Spotify legal terms, policies, and notices.
- [Privacy Center](https://www.spotify.com/privacy/): Privacy information, controls, and policy resources for Spotify users.

## Company and News
- [Newsroom](https://newsroom.spotify.com/): Official Spotify news, announcements, product updates, and company stories.
- [Company Info](https://www.spotify.com/about-us/contact/): Corporate information and contact resources for Spotify.
- [Jobs](https://www.lifeatspotify.com/): Careers, culture, and open roles across Spotify teams.
- [Investor Relations](https://investors.spotify.com/): Financial reports, governance, and investor information for Spotify.
- [For the Record](https://newsroom.spotify.com/news/): News and editorial updates from Spotify’s newsroom.
- [Press](https://newsroom.spotify.com/press/): Media resources, press contacts, and brand materials.
